original_intent: Make Dactyl route the unchanged application execution contract to local SQLite or Propodus Vercel/Neon from ambient configuration, preserve the local path, keep Dactyl thin, publish one PR, and update associated issues.
derived_intent: Implement and prove only Dactyl route/config/transport/normalization behavior supported by current code and linked contracts; leave live deployment parity and cross-repository ownership as explicit issue dependencies.
active_boundaries: Dactyl owns physical route selection, binding, transport, atomicity, access mode, normalized results, and typed physical errors; Decapod owns domain/migration/retry/governance; Propodus owns hosting/auth/tenancy/schema/transactions/idempotency.
repo_scope: src/lib.rs, src/adapter/neon/mod.rs, tests/conformance.rs, tests/lib route behavior, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, living specs and governed artifacts required for one Dactyl PR; no direct .decapod state edits or cross-repository code.

loops.feedback: Ambient SQLite/Neon routing and typed remote result normalization are locally verified; protected deployed parity remains an explicit external gate.
